contract.instructions:
CONTRACT-ONLY fleshing-out; do not implement.
Source anchors: plan §7.5 row line 2139 (build the canonical declaration from the sealed plan, verify it, create the contract index, seal the concrete graph, then seal contracts; output declaration, CONTRACT_INDEX.json, graph, and plan-bound contract seal); §7.6 evidence row line 2414 (unmet precondition: graph declaration, family list, or one contract index is absent; validating assertion: graph validates, contract index has four entries, and seal rehashes); §7.2 lines 1639-1647 and 1988-1992 (seal order and no-self-reference rule); §8.2 Gate-1 acceptance (R1.5 creates CONTRACT_INDEX.json and seals the base task graph with templates, request contract, and contracts; no graph/seal digest cycle exists).
Prerequisite edge (exact prerequisite table, plan line 1739): R1.5: R1.T1, R1.T2, R1.1, R1.2, R1.3, R1.4.
focused_command is the plan-specified §7.5 chained command; it depends on scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.mjs and scripts/ranking-v3-contract-seal.mjs (R1.T1/R1.T2-owned, neither exists at round_base) and on sealed contract indexes from R1.1-R1.4, so it is unverifiable-at-base. affected_command pnpm test:scripts is repo-verified (package.json line 26).
This is an execution card, not a code-change card: verification uses the §7.6 unmet-precondition check then the validating assertion; no first-RED test is required.
Execution order is normative and must not be reordered: build-declaration, then verify-declaration, then build-index, then seal the graph (which expands E1.<familyId>/E2.<familyId> from $LOFO_FAMILIES via the R1.T1 expansion function), then seal contracts. The seal binds planSha256 and taskGraphSha256 but the graph never contains a seal digest. $CONTRACT_INDEX/$CONTRACT_SEAL/$TASK_GRAPH are the R1.5 output paths (plan §7.5 variable table lines 2096-2098).
